name: Factory Defect
source:
Lucky is a combat bot looking for fun after her mechanic pissed her off. She knows what she wants and where to get it, it's just a matter of finding someone else looking for a good time.

[Edited from [url=https://intothesinx.itch.io/factory-defect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Lucky是一个战斗机器人，在她的机械师惹恼了她之后正在寻找乐趣。她知道自己想要什么，也知道从哪里得到它，只需找到其他人来享受美好时光即可。

[编辑自[url=https://intothesinx.itch.io/factory-defect]itch.io[/url]]
